title: Conformance run file
description: What a client's runner records for one renderer; tools/report.mjs turns one or more of these into the report. See CLIENTS.md.

renderer.description: The renderer's name in the client (e.g. wkwebview, twidget-core, litehtml-swift).

engine.description: Free text: OS / engine version, device.

framework.description: The widget-sandbox tag or commit the client is on.

width.description: Widget width in CSS px (points / dp).

dead.description: Why the runtime died, if it did.

status.description: The last published status (done / awaiting / running).

checks.description: The `checks` array of the last data-conformance value, verbatim: [catalogue id, name, status, detail].

stages.description: Auto set: one entry per stage of manifest.tests[].stages for this theme. Either a crop (judged by report.mjs) or a judgement made with tools/diff.mjs.

crop.description: PNG of the stage at DPR 2 (size × 2), path relative to the run file.

observed.description: What the host saw, for manifest.tests[].host.

bridge.description: Bridge calls the host accepted (after the gesture gate), in order.

height.description: The bubble height the host gave the widget at the end (CSS px).

chatFocused.description: The chat input still had the focus after the widget booted, before any input.

syntheticInput.description: The runner's input grants no user gesture (gesture-gated host checks are skipped).

host.description: Alternatively, host checks already judged: [{id, name, status, detail}].

skippedActions.description: Indices into manifest.tests[].actions (or action kinds) this client could not perform; the checks they feed are skipped.
